options.label: 按货收，不多管
options.result: 未垫款，回共同线，不安排共事来访
options.label_en: Just buy the goods, nothing more

segments.prompt_en: She's still short on the detective's fee

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 鼓胀的旧布袋落上柜台，袋口用旧鞋带扎着。
lines.en: A bulging old cloth sack lands on the counter, its mouth tied with an old shoelace.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我在垃圾场翻了两晚，都在袋子里了。
lines.en: Two nights digging through the scrapyard. It's all in the sack.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 东西给你分成了三堆。
lines.en: I sorted it into three piles for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 左边是接口和线材，右边是能用的外壳。
lines.en: Left is connectors and cables, right is usable casings.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 中间那几个我拿不准，你自己看。
lines.en: The middle ones I'm not sure about. You look.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那包小的呢？
lines.en: And the small bundle?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那是弯了针脚的坏件，我单独包出来了。
lines.en: Broken parts with bent pins. I wrapped them separately.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 室友让我混进好料里蒙人，我不干那种事。
lines.en: My roommate told me to mix them in with the good stuff. I don't do that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 被人蒙过一次，就懂那滋味有多恶心。
lines.en: Get cheated once, and you know how disgusting it feels.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再说你上次按成色收货，我也守你的规矩。
lines.en: Besides, you paid by condition last time. I keep to your rules too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你手上有黑灰。
lines.en: Your hands are black with grime.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少看我的手，我已经洗过三遍了。
lines.en: Stop looking at my hands. I've washed them three times.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 机油渗进指甲缝里，根本搓不掉。
lines.en: Machine oil gets under the nails. It won't scrub out.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她从兜里摸出旧袜子改的钱袋按在台面上。
lines.en: She pulls a coin purse made from an old sock out of her pocket and presses it on the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我得凑够八百信用点，请下层侦探去查案。
lines.en: I need eight hundred credits to hire a Lower Level detective.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 只有翻出农场的旧账，才能洗清母亲的罪名。
lines.en: Only digging up the farm's old ledger can clear my mother's name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可袋里只有五百出头，全按好价算也还差一截。
lines.en: But there's barely over five hundred here. Even at top price, I'm still short.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 差得不算少。
lines.en: That's not a small gap.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 丑话说在前头，你别可怜我故意抬价。
lines.en: Let me be clear: don't pity me and inflate the price.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你要是敢多给，我现在就拎着袋子走人。
lines.en: If you dare overpay, I'm taking my sack and walking out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 看守再过几天就换班，我怕记录被人撕少几页。
lines.en: The guards change shifts in a few days. I'm afraid pages of the records will go missing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 照这个速度去翻垃圾场，还得熬上十来天。
lines.en: At this rate, scrapyard digging will take another ten days or so.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 十来天太久了。
lines.en: Ten days is too long.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 久也没办法，你先看货开价吧。
lines.en: Long or not, there's no other way. Just look at the goods and name a price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我按货收，别的不管。
lines.en: I pay for the goods. Nothing else.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼，我本来也没指望别人替我掏钱。
lines.en: Hmph. I never expected anyone to pay for me anyway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 按你的规矩来就行，不用跟我客气。
lines.en: Go by your rules. No need to be polite with me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这三堆旧料都在台面上，你报个价吧。
lines.en: All three piles are on the counter. Name your price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 卖完差多少，我补。
lines.en: Whatever you're short after selling, I'll cover.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （怔了一下）你知不知道自己在说什么？
lines.en: (Freezes for a moment) Do you even know what you're saying?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道。
lines.en: I do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先说清楚，那些钱算我向你借的。
lines.en: Let's be clear: that money is a loan.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我不白拿别人的东西，以后一定还你。
lines.en: I don't take things for free. I'll pay you back.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 可以。
lines.en: Fine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你先帮我认认中间那几件，看看能抵多少。
lines.en: Then help me identify the middle ones first. See what they're worth.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 跟你估的差不多，你的眼光还算公道。
lines.en: About what I estimated. Your eye's fair enough.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那我只拿还差的那一截，多一分我都不要。
lines.en: Then I'll take only what I'm short. Not a credit more.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拿着吧。
lines.en: Take it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明天我写好借条带过来，绝不赖账。
lines.en: I'll bring a signed IOU tomorrow. I won't skip out on it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，那几块旧外壳哪值这个价？
lines.en: Hey, those old casings aren't worth that much.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你多算出来的部分，必须从要补的那截里扣掉。
lines.en: Whatever you overpaid comes out of what you're covering.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 随你。
lines.en: Suit yourself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一分一毫都得对平，我才不会欠你人情。
lines.en: Every last credit has to balance. I won't owe you any favors.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 比我想的低一点，不过你是行家。
lines.en: A bit lower than I thought, but you're the expert.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 既然成色只有这样，那就按你说的算。
lines.en: If that's all the condition's worth, we'll go with your price.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 只是你要补的那一截变长了，你可别后悔。
lines.en: But the gap you're covering just got bigger. Don't regret it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说了补，就补。
lines.en: I said I'd cover it. I will.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行，明天我就带借条过来找你。
lines.en: Fine. I'll bring you an IOU tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这个价谈不拢，东西我还是收回去。
lines.en: If we can't agree on a price, I'm taking this back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 既然货没卖成，你刚才说补钱的话也先不作数。
lines.en: Since there's no sale, your offer to cover the gap doesn't count either.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我不会白拿你整笔钱，改天我再带别的料来。
lines.en: I won't take your money for nothing. I'll bring other materials another day.

options.label: 婉拒
options.result: 婉拒共事，回共同线；已垫款项仍用于调查

segments.prompt_en: She offers to work at the shop

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 侦探已经去查农场旧账和值夜工人了。
lines.en: The detective's gone to look into the farm's old records and the night-shift workers.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他说现有的证据太完美，反倒像刻意做出来的。
lines.en: He says the evidence is too perfect. It looks staged.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 接下来得想办法进母亲的旧实验室看一眼。
lines.en: Next, I need to find a way into my mother's old lab.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你补给我的那截钱，全都花在查案上了。
lines.en: The money you covered for me all went into the investigation.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没催你。
lines.en: I didn't ask.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一张折过的手写纸按在窗口台面上。
lines.en: A folded handwritten note is pressed onto the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 光靠翻垃圾场太慢，我想来你店里干活抵债。
lines.en: Scavenging the junkyard is too slow. I want to work off my debt in your shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 认货、记账还有跑腿，我全都拿得下来。
lines.en: Appraising, bookkeeping, running errands. I can handle all of it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上层区的布料、表壳和瓷器根本骗不过我。
lines.en: Upper Level fabrics, watch cases, porcelain. None of it fools me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这两天看过的线材和接口，我也全都记熟了。
lines.en: And I've memorized every cable and connector I've seen these past two days.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你还会记账？
lines.en: You keep ledgers too?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 小时候我常帮母亲抄农场的进出账目。
lines.en: As a child, I often copied the farm's ledgers for my mother.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你按天算工钱，留够饭钱后剩下的全扣去抵债。
lines.en: Pay me by the day. After food money, the rest goes to my debt.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 但我拾荒淘来的货得另外算，不能混进工钱里。
lines.en: But what I scavenge gets counted separately. Don't mix it into my wages.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要干多久？
lines.en: For how long?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一直干到我母亲的案子水落石出为止。
lines.en: Until my mother's case is solved.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 将来我要堂堂正正用自己的名字回上层区。
lines.en: Someday I'll return to the Upper Level under my own name, with my head held high.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 到那时候，我还得借你在下层区的门路帮衬。
lines.en: When that time comes, I'll still need your Lower Level connections.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 至于母亲和研究的事，全由我自己做主。
lines.en: As for my mother and her research, I make those calls myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有，我可只叫你店主。
lines.en: And I'll only ever call you shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 本来也没指望。
lines.en: Wasn't expecting otherwise.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （哼笑一声）你要是肯签，那张纸就归你收着。
lines.en: (Scoffs) If you'll sign, that note is yours to keep.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 店里不缺人。
lines.en: I'm not short-handed.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行，那这张纸我自己收回去。
lines.en: Fine. Then I'll take the note back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 欠你的钱我会按时还，案子我也自己想办法。
lines.en: I'll repay you on time, and I'll handle the case myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 等我再去翻出好料子，照样拿来卖给你。
lines.en: When I dig up good materials again, I'll still bring them to you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天开门前来。
lines.en: Come before we open tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 带支笔。
lines.en: Bring a pen.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把折纸仔细收进怀里的内袋。
lines.en: She carefully tucks the note into her inner pocket.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要是迟到你尽管扣钱，乱扣我可要找你算账。
lines.en: Dock my pay if I'm late. Dock it unfairly and you'll answer to me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先前补钱的事，谢谢你。
lines.en: About covering the money earlier... thank you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就这一声，别指望我再说第二遍。
lines.en: That's the only time. Don't expect me to say it twice.

scenes.title_en: The Disk in the False Bottom

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺按着外套内袋走到窗口前，回头确认巷子里没人。
lines.en: Eleanor walks up to the window, hand on her coat's inner pocket, and glances back to make sure the alley is empty.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 侦探昨晚摸进母亲的旧实验室了。
lines.en: The detective snuck into my mother's old lab last night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 里面早就搬空了，但他撬开旧抽屉底下的夹层，摸出一块数据盘。
lines.en: It was cleared out long ago, but he pried open a hidden compartment under an old drawer and found a data disk.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 打开了？
lines.en: Opened it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他试了母亲的名字和农场编号，全都打不开。
lines.en: He tried my mother's name and the farm's ID number. Neither worked.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我拿过来输了自己的生日，一次就解开了。
lines.en: I took it and entered my birthday. It unlocked on the first try.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 十岁生日那天她在实验室忙到半夜，我还赌气嚷她忘了我生日。
lines.en: On my tenth birthday, she worked in the lab until midnight. I sulked and yelled that she'd forgotten my birthday.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 盘里有什么？
lines.en: What's on the drive?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 全是营养果的实验记录，市面上卖的果子籽都是死的。
lines.en: All Nutrifruit research notes. The seeds sold on the market are all dead.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 农场每次种新的一茬，都得花大价钱向上面买苗。
lines.en: Every new crop, the farms have to pay a fortune for seedlings from up top.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲一直在研究怎么让营养果重新结出活籽。
lines.en: Mother was always researching how to make Nutrifruit bear living seeds again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 记录最后几页画了好几个大圈，写着有一小批种子已经冒芽了。
lines.en: The last few pages are circled over and over. A small batch of seeds had already sprouted.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 里面还有帕斯泰尔公司发来的好几封信。
lines.en: There are also several letters from the Pastel company.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最开始还客客气气劝她暂缓，后来直接勒令她停手交出资料。
lines.en: At first they politely urged her to hold off. Later they ordered her to stop and hand over her data.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲没有交，结果不到一个月就被他们抓走了。
lines.en: Mother refused. Less than a month later, they took her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怕她断了财路。
lines.en: Afraid she'd cut off their profits.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我和侦探也是这么猜的，不过信里倒没白纸黑字写出来。
lines.en: That's what the detective and I guessed too, but the letters never say it outright.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我那个室友平时爱乱翻东西，这盘绝不能放在房间里。
lines.en: My roommate likes rummaging through things. This drive can't stay in the room.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在我贴身收着，也绝不会傻到直接交给上面。
lines.en: I keep it on me now, and I'm not foolish enough to hand it to the people up top.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要是东西落进他们手里，母亲就真的没有半点用处了。
lines.en: If it falls into their hands, Mother will truly be worth nothing to them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 除了侦探，这件事我只告诉了你一个人，你可给我把嘴闭紧点。
lines.en: Besides the detective, you're the only one I've told. Keep your mouth shut.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 放心。
lines.en: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把台面上的账本翻开，指尖停在纸页边沿。
lines.en: She opens the ledger on the counter, fingertips resting on the edge of the page.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你说，母亲把盘藏进夹层那天，是不是早就知道自己要出事？
lines.en: Tell me—the day Mother hid the drive in that compartment, did she already know something would happen to her?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先写账。
lines.en: Ledger first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （轻哼）不用你催，今天新收的旧货还没核完呢。
lines.en: (Scoffs) No need to rush me. I haven't finished checking today's secondhand intake.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一个男人走到窗口前没看货架，手臂直接压上柜台。
lines.en: A man walks up to the window, ignores the shelves, and plants his arm on the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 买什么？
lines.en: Buying something?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 不买货，专挑那个替你认货记账的上层丫头不在时过来。
lines.en: Not buying. I waited until that Upper Level girl who appraises and keeps your ledger was out.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 让她把旧实验室带出来的那块盘交出来。
lines.en: Tell her to hand over the drive she took from the old lab.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 东西交出来，自然有人告诉她去哪儿换人。
lines.en: Once she does, someone will tell her where to collect her mother.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你们是谁？
lines.en: Who are you people?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 谁派来的你少打听，她母亲现在还在牢里关着呢。
lines.en: Don't ask who sent me. Her mother's still locked up in prison.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 牢里的伙食和台阶，还有值夜的人哪个靠得住？
lines.en: Prison food, prison stairs, the night guards—which of those can you trust?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 夜里不小心摔一跤或者闹几天肚子，谁能说得清。
lines.en: A slip in the night, a few days of a bad stomach—who could say how it happened?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他从怀里掏出一沓信用点，重重拍在柜台角上。
lines.en: He pulls a stack of credits from his coat and slaps it down on the corner of the counter.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 这三百信用点是给你的跑腿钱。
lines.en: These three hundred credits are for your trouble.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 来路不明，不接。
lines.en: Dirty money. Not taking it.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 不接就搁那儿，我可没工夫再揣回去。
lines.en: Then leave it there. I'm not carrying it back.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你只管把我的原话一字不差地转告她。
lines.en: Just pass my words on to her exactly.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 盘交出来，人就放出来。
lines.en: She hands over the drive, her mother walks free.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 要是拖久了，她母亲还能不能出来可不好讲。
lines.en: If she drags her feet, whether her mother gets out at all is hard to say.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 就这些？
lines.en: That all?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 给她三天时间考虑，三天后我再来听信。
lines.en: She has three days to think. I'll be back for her answer.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 顺便劝你们一句，最好别打治安部的主意。
lines.en: And a word of advice: don't get ideas about Public Security.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 那张台子后头，有的是人嘴比你还快。
lines.en: Behind that desk, plenty of people have looser lips than you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道了。
lines.en: Got it.

options.label: 交盘换人
options.result: 交盘换人：研究归还，母亲获释，流放下层

options.label: 立即公开
options.result: 立即公开：母亲死亡，进入革命军线

segments.prompt_en: Eleanor's plan to save her mother

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那沓三百信用点原封不动地压在柜台角上。
lines.en: The stack of three hundred credits sits untouched on the corner of the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 柜台角上那沓钱是哪儿来的？
lines.en: Where did that stack of money on the counter come from?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚才有人过来留话。
lines.en: Someone came by and left a message.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 让你交盘换你母亲出来。
lines.en: Hand over the drive, and your mother goes free.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把那个人留下的原话再念一遍。
lines.en: Repeat exactly what that man said.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 牢里伙食和台阶靠不住。
lines.en: Prison food and stairs can't be trusted.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 值夜的人也一样。
lines.en: Neither can the night guards.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这三百是跑腿钱，限三天。
lines.en: This three hundred is for your trouble. You have three days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他们竟然拿三百块买我母亲一条命！
lines.en: They think three hundred buys my mother's life!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你先别插嘴，让我自己想清楚。
lines.en: Don't interrupt. Let me think this through.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第一条路是交出数据盘去换人。
lines.en: Option one: hand over the data disk in exchange for her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那样我母亲半辈子的研究就全废了。
lines.en: Then half a lifetime of my mother's research is gone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第二条路是现在就把数据盘公开出去。
lines.en: Option two: make the data disk public right now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 虽然痛快，可我母亲还在牢里关着呢。
lines.en: Satisfying, but my mother is still locked up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第三条路是把威胁递上去申请转监保护。
lines.en: Option three: report the threat and request a protective transfer.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 数据盘先留着，但得找可靠的人去递话。
lines.en: Keep the disk for now, but find someone reliable to pass word along.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上次查箱子认识个警官。
lines.en: I met an officer during that crate inspection.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不走前厅，直接找他。
lines.en: Skip the front desk. Go straight to him.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （盯着那沓钱）……这件事我自己定。
lines.en: (Staring at the stack of cash) ...I'll decide this myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 研究让他们拿走吧，只要母亲能活着出来。
lines.en: Let them take the research, as long as Mother gets out alive.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哪怕以后我们母女一直住下层区也行。
lines.en: Even if we stay in the Lower Level for good.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好，三天后我回话。
lines.en: Fine. I'll give my answer in three days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我现在就把盘里的东西全抖出去！
lines.en: I'm putting everything on that disk out there, now!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让全空间站的人都看看他们干的好事！
lines.en: Let the whole station see what they've done!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想清楚了？
lines.en: Thought it through?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 想清楚了，谁都别拦我。
lines.en: I have. Nobody stop me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的研究不能交，人我也要保住。
lines.en: I won't hand over Mother's research, and I'll keep her safe.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我把威胁原话和那人的长相全写下来。
lines.en: I'll write down the threat word for word, and what the man looked like.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 连几点过来的都记清楚再递上去。
lines.en: Down to what time he came, then submit it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那三百块也原封送去。
lines.en: The three hundred goes in untouched too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 正好当物证。
lines.en: It'll serve as evidence.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你帮我问清能不能避开原来那批值夜的人。
lines.en: Ask whether she can be kept away from that same night shift.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 盘我先留着，等正式复核时我亲手交。
lines.en: I'll keep the disk and hand it over myself at the formal review.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺从账本上撕下一页纸，低头迅速写完记录。
lines.en: Eleanor tears a page from the ledger and quickly writes out the record.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 出门前帮我核一遍上面有没有错字。
lines.en: Check it for typos before I go.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺扶住窗外的木凳坐下，腿还有些发软。
lines.en: Eleanor steadies herself on the wooden bench outside the window and sits, legs still weak.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 治安部把那份记录收了，那三百块也封存了。
lines.en: Security took the record, and sealed the three hundred as evidence.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 人转走了？
lines.en: She's been moved?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨天下午刚换了地方，现在有专人看顾。
lines.en: Yesterday afternoon. Someone's assigned to watch over her now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 原来值夜的那批人已经碰不到她了。
lines.en: That night shift can't get to her anymore.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 经手那位还偷偷给我看了一张母亲写的字条。
lines.en: The officer handling it even slipped me a note from my mother.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 写了什么？
lines.en: What did it say?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面就写了“我很好，别乱跑”六个字。
lines.en: Just: "I'm fine. Stay put."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 字迹歪得厉害，不过我母亲一着急写字就那样。
lines.en: The writing was badly crooked, but that's how she writes when she's anxious.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 案子还要重新核查，暂时没给准话。
lines.en: The case will be re-examined. No firm answer yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 数据盘我还贴身带着，三天早过了那人也没敢再来。
lines.en: I still keep the disk on me. Three days came and went, and he never dared come back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 侦探打听到那边已经有人被治安部叫去问话了。
lines.en: The detective heard someone on their side has been called in by Security for questioning.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 能探视吗？
lines.en: Can you visit her?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在还见不到她，不过只要人安全我就等得起。
lines.en: Not yet. But as long as she's safe, I can wait.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （垂下眼）……前几天我其实差点就把盘交出去了。
lines.en: (Lowering her eyes) ...A few days ago, I nearly handed the disk over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 只要你当时劝我一句，我兴许就真妥协了。
lines.en: If you'd said one word back then, I might actually have given in.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你帮我跑腿递记录的事，不算工钱也不算借款。
lines.en: Running errands and delivering records for me—that's not wages, and not a loan either.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那算什么？
lines.en: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先不算，等我想好了再告诉你。
lines.en: Nothing yet. I'll tell you once I've decided.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺站起身，伸手把柜台边的账本拉到面前。
lines.en: Eleanor stands and pulls the ledger at the edge of the counter toward her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少贫嘴，你昨天收的那把旧锤子连锤头松了都没登记。
lines.en: Enough lip. That old hammer you took in yesterday has a loose head, and you never logged it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一个把头发拢得整整齐齐、袖口磨起毛边的女人走到窗口前。
lines.en: A woman with neatly gathered hair and frayed cuffs steps up to the window.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你好，我是埃莉诺的母亲索菲娅。
lines.en: Hello. I'm Sophia, Eleanor's mother.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 看护那边准我出来一小时，陪同的人还在街口等我。
lines.en: My caretakers gave me an hour out. My escort's waiting at the end of the street.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我想买个喝水杯、一盏夜里不闪的灯，再拿套擦洗用具。
lines.en: I'd like a drinking cup, a lamp that doesn't flicker at night, and a cleaning kit.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺提起过你，说你这儿买东西会先把毛病讲清楚。
lines.en: Eleanor mentioned you. Said you tell people what's wrong with things before they buy.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 杯底有磕口，不漏水。
lines.en: Chipped base. Doesn't leak.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不漏就行，你果然像她说的那样实在。
lines.en: No leak is fine. You really are as straightforward as she said.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她平时在别人面前可没这么爱念叨。
lines.en: She's not usually this chatty around others.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她在这儿话不少。
lines.en: She talks plenty here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那说明她在你这儿待着心里踏实。
lines.en: Then she must feel at ease here with you.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她小的时候话也少，一不说话就喜欢自己哼歌。
lines.en: She was quiet as a child too. When she went quiet, she'd hum to herself.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那时候专门跟老师学过几年，老师一直夸她嗓子条件好。
lines.en: She studied with a teacher for a few years. The teacher always praised her voice.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 后来年纪大点，稍微有人打趣两句，她嫌丢面子就不唱了。
lines.en: When she got older, a little teasing was enough. She felt embarrassed and stopped singing.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这话你听听就算了，可别主动去问她，不然她准怪我不替她瞒着。
lines.en: Just keep that to yourself. Don't ask her, or she'll blame me for not covering for her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不提。
lines.en: I won't bring it up.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那个数据盘还在她手里攥着，这股倔劲倒是随了我。
lines.en: She's still clutching that data disk. That stubborn streak she got from me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这几样日用品我都挑好了，你按店里平常的实价算。
lines.en: I've picked out these few things. Charge me your usual honest price.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别因为我是她母亲，就在账上给我少算钱。
lines.en: Don't knock anything off just because I'm her mother.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 价钱很实在，今天晚上回去就能换上新灯了。
lines.en: A fair price. I can put the new lamp in tonight.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 东西我拿走了，谢谢你，老板。
lines.en: I'll take these. Thank you, shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 下层区的日用品行情我问过，你还是给我少算了。
lines.en: I've asked around about Lower Level prices. You still undercharged me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 今天这几样我先收下，下次再来你必须按原价算。
lines.en: I'll accept these today, but next time you charge full price.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别让我一个做长辈的站在窗口前跟你争这点钱。
lines.en: Don't make an elder stand at your window haggling over pocket change.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这个数目比配给站附近的铺子贵了一截，不过我照付。
lines.en: That's a fair bit more than the shops near the ration station, but I'll pay it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺现在就在你店里帮忙记账，这笔账你最好别让她翻到。
lines.en: Eleanor keeps your books now. You'd better hope she doesn't find this entry.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 既然价钱谈不拢，那这几样东西我今天先不买了。
lines.en: If we can't agree on a price, I won't buy these today.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 屋里那盏闪个不停的旧灯，再凑合忍几天也能用。
lines.en: That old flickering lamp at home will do for a few more days.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一个把头发拢得整整齐齐、袖口磨起毛边的女人走到窗口前。
lines.en: A woman with neatly gathered hair and frayed cuffs steps up to the window.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你好，我是埃莉诺的母亲索菲娅。
lines.en: Hello. I'm Sophia, Eleanor's mother.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我刚从上面放出来，现在跟她一起挤在配给站对面的小屋里。
lines.en: I was just released from up there. Now she and I are squeezed into a little room across from the ration station.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 屋里缺个喝水杯和一盏夜里不闪的灯，还得添套擦洗用具。
lines.en: We need a drinking cup, a lamp that doesn't flicker at night, and a cleaning kit.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺提起过你，说你这儿买东西会先把毛病讲清楚。
lines.en: Eleanor mentioned you. Said you tell people what's wrong with things before they buy.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 杯底有磕口，不漏水。
lines.en: Chipped base. Doesn't leak.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不漏就行，你果然像她说的那样实在。
lines.en: No leak is fine. You really are as straightforward as she said.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她平时在别人面前可没这么爱念叨。
lines.en: She's not usually this chatty around others.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她在这儿话不少。
lines.en: She talks plenty here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那说明她在你这儿待着心里踏实。
lines.en: Then she must feel at ease here with you.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她小的时候话也少，一不说话就喜欢自己哼歌。
lines.en: She was quiet as a child too. When she went quiet, she'd hum to herself.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那时候专门跟老师学过几年，老师一直夸她嗓子条件好。
lines.en: She studied with a teacher for a few years. The teacher always praised her voice.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 后来年纪大点，稍微有人打趣两句，她嫌丢面子就不唱了。
lines.en: When she got older, a little teasing was enough. She found it embarrassing and stopped singing.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这话你听听就算了，可别主动去问她，不然她准怪我不替她瞒着。
lines.en: Just keep this to yourself. Don't go asking her, or she'll blame me for not covering for her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不提。
lines.en: I won't bring it up.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那份数据盘已经交回去换我出来了，她却宁可留在下层陪我。
lines.en: That data disk was handed back to get me out, yet she'd rather stay on the Lower Level with me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这几样日用品我都挑好了，你按店里平常的实价算。
lines.en: I've picked out these household goods. Charge me the shop's usual price.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别因为我是她母亲，就在账上给我少算钱。
lines.en: Don't knock anything off the ledger just because I'm her mother.

segments.prompt_en: Did she get the coat's story right?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗口后的旧货架照她的主意重排过，每格前都压着手写小纸条。
lines.en: The old shelves behind the window have been rearranged her way, a handwritten note tucked under each slot.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你今天倒是看看后面那排架子，我已经全都重新理顺了。
lines.en: Take a look at that back row of shelves today. I've reorganized all of it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前把所有旧货混着堆，找件小东西都要翻上半天。
lines.en: Before, all the secondhand goods were piled together. Finding anything small took forever.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我现在改成按原来的主人放，谁送来的就归在同一格里。
lines.en: Now I sort by original owner. Whoever brought it in, it all goes in the same slot.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最上面一格全是修船坞那位老伯退下来的旧铁器，手柄上还带着机油印。
lines.en: The top slot is all old ironware the old man from the dry dock retired. The handles still have oil stains.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 中间那排是几户搬家清出来的日用品，杯碗和灯具我都擦干净了。
lines.en: The middle row is household goods from a few families who moved. I wiped the cups, bowls, and lamps clean.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 底下那格全是我自己去捡来的货，还是照老规矩单独记账。
lines.en: The bottom slot is everything I scavenged myself. Still logged separately, same as always.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 每样东西的来历我都写在纸条上，客人问起也绝不会瞎编。
lines.en: Every item's history is on its note. If a customer asks, I never make things up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚才那人来看了灰外套。
lines.en: That customer just looked at the gray coat.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你那时候明明在里屋清点工具，怎么连这都听见了。
lines.en: ...You were in the back counting tools. How did you even hear that?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 既然你听见了，那我正好拿这件灰外套考考你。
lines.en: Since you heard it, I'll test you with this gray coat.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你看它右袖手肘上有三道补丁，缝线的颜色一道比一道浅。
lines.en: Look. Three patches on the right elbow, each thread lighter than the last.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前面两道针脚又密又匀，肯定是他家里那位常做针线的妻子补的。
lines.en: The first two have tight, even stitches. Must be his wife, who sews a lot.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可最上面这道针脚突然变大了，收尾打结的手法也完全换了个人。
lines.en: But the top one's stitches suddenly get bigger, and the knot is tied by someone else entirely.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我就照实跟客人讲，这件衣服家里先后有两个人替原主缝补过。
lines.en: So I told the customer straight: two people in that household mended this for its owner.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我没替原主卖惨，也没故意把价钱往高里吹。
lines.en: I didn't spin a sob story for the owner, and I didn't inflate the price.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那位客人摸了半天袖口，说下次带妻子一起来挑。
lines.en: He fingered the cuff for ages and said he'd bring his wife next time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，我刚才给人家讲的那些，你觉得对不对？
lines.en: Hey, what I just told him. Was I right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 讲得好。
lines.en: Well told.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 算你有眼光，那你猜第三道补丁是谁缝的？
lines.en: Good eye. Then guess who sewed the third patch.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那个儿子，左手拿针。
lines.en: The son. Left-handed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 针脚往左斜，签字也用左手。
lines.en: The stitches slant left. He signs left-handed too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你看着她只点了一下头。
lines.en: You just look at her and nod once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我就说了这么半天，你连半句评价都懒得给吗？
lines.en: I talked all that time, and you can't spare half a word?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第三道是那个儿子左手补的。
lines.en: The son patched the third one, left-handed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 针脚往左斜，签字也用左手。
lines.en: The stitches slant left. He signs left-handed too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你明明早就看出来了，刚才怎么不早点告诉我。
lines.en: ...You saw it ages ago. Why didn't you tell me sooner?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 害我在账本背面画了个问号，我现在就把它改过来。
lines.en: I drew a question mark on the back of the ledger because of you. I'm fixing it now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一上午跟好几拨客人讲货，说得我嗓子都有点干了。
lines.en: Pitching goods to customers all morning. My throat's gone a little dry.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （坐回窗口外的凳子上，轻轻揉了下脖子）
lines.en: (Sits back on the stool outside the window, lightly rubbing her neck)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 午间的巷子渐渐静下来，窗口前没了旁人。
lines.en: The alley quiets at midday. No one else is at the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在整条巷子都没别人，只有我们两个。
lines.en: There's no one else in the whole alley now. Just the two of us.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……主人。
lines.en: ...Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （举起账本挡住半张脸）客人跟前你可别应。
lines.en: (Raises the ledger to hide half her face) Don't answer to that in front of customers.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要是让别人听见了，我以后绝对不会再叫第二次。
lines.en: If anyone else hears it, I'm never saying it again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。
lines.en: Okay.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……那我先写账了，主人。
lines.en: ...I'll do the ledger then, Master.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第三道是那个儿子补的。
lines.en: The son patched the third one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 针脚往左斜，左手拿针。
lines.en: The stitches slant left. He holds the needle left-handed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他上次来签字也用左手。
lines.en: He signed left-handed last time, too.

segments.prompt_en: How to respond to the confession

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她合上账本把笔别进侧边，顺着窗台推到你的手边。
lines.en: She closes the ledger, tucks the pen into its spine, and slides it along the sill to your hand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天的账目全都核对完了，连半个数字都没差。
lines.en: Today's accounts are all checked. Not a single figure off.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 班我已经交了，现在待在这儿可不算工时。
lines.en: My shift's over. Staying here doesn't count as work hours.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就算将来母亲的案子复核下来，我也还想来给你看店。
lines.en: Even after Mother's case is reviewed, I'd still want to mind the shop for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哪怕遇上没工的日子，我也想过来看看你。
lines.en: Even on days with no work, I'd want to come see you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你听好了，这话我可不打算说第二遍。
lines.en: Listen carefully. I'm not saying this twice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我喜欢你。
lines.en: I like you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想跟你谈恋爱，可我还想私下叫你主人。
lines.en: I want to be with you. But I still want to call you Master in private.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这两样我都想要，你到底肯不肯？
lines.en: I want both. Will you agree or not?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也是。
lines.en: Same here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也喜欢你。
lines.en: I like you too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （偏开脸）……这句倒还算中听，主人。
lines.en: (Looks away) ...That one's not bad to hear, Master.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺。
lines.en: Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 以后在外面也这么喊你。
lines.en: That's what I'll call you in public.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……嗯，在外面就这么喊我。
lines.en: ...Mm. Call me that in public.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没人的时候，我就叫你主人。
lines.en: When no one's around, I'll call you Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 既然你亲口应了，账本就在手底下按着，不许反悔。
lines.en: You said yes yourself. The ledger's under my hand, so no taking it back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她隔着账本伏近窗台边，伸手轻轻勾住你的袖口。
lines.en: She leans over the ledger toward the sill and lightly hooks your cuff.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，刚才我说话的时候，你的眼神往哪儿看呢？
lines.en: Hey, where were your eyes while I was talking?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 既然现在是你的人了，有件事我只告诉你一个人。
lines.en: Now that I'm yours, there's something I'll tell only you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上次母亲过来买日用品，肯定把我小时候唱歌的事漏给你了。
lines.en: When Mother came for supplies, she surely let slip that I sang as a child.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那时候确实跟着老师学过几年，后来嫌当众开口丢面子就停了。
lines.en: I did study with a teacher for a few years, then quit. Singing in public felt embarrassing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 被赶到下层区的这段日子，我更是连一声都没哼过。
lines.en: Since being driven to the Lower Level, I haven't hummed a single note.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可这几天在窗前理那些旧货，以前的调子自己从嘴边冒出来了。
lines.en: But sorting old goods by the window these days, old tunes just slip out on their own.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 等案子彻底了结，我还是想重新站到台上去唱。
lines.en: Once the case is fully settled, I want to sing on stage again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我要堂堂正正报我自己的名字，唱给台下的人听。
lines.en: Under my own name, openly, for the people in the audience.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱什么歌全都由我自己挑，谁也别想在背后指手画脚。
lines.en: I'll choose every song myself. No one gets to meddle behind my back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不过你今天可别指望我在这扇窗前唱头一句。
lines.en: But don't expect me to sing the first line at this window today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头一回正式开口，总得挑个像样点的地方。
lines.en: My first real performance deserves a proper venue.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我等着。
lines.en: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （松开你的袖口）那可说定了，你到时候不许缺席。
lines.en: (Lets go of your cuff) Then it's settled. You'd better not miss it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 天快黑透了，我先回配给站对面去。
lines.en: It's nearly dark. I'm heading back across from the ration station.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明天我会早点过来，主人。
lines.en: I'll come early tomorrow, Master.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 两样都给你。
lines.en: You can have both.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你倒是一口就应下来了，连犹豫都不带一下。
lines.en: ...You agreed right away. Not even a moment's hesitation.

segments.prompt_en: Respond to her wanting to audition

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 柜台边靠着一只旧电线扎口的拾荒袋。
lines.en: A scavenger's bag tied shut with old wire leans against the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天我特意早到了半个钟头，趁没客人跟你谈件正事。
lines.en: I came half an hour early today to talk business before customers show up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前天跟你说等母亲的案子了结再去唱歌，我改主意了。
lines.en: The other day I said I'd sing after Mother's case closed. I've changed my mind.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 复核程序还不知道要拖多久，我实在等不及那时候了。
lines.en: Who knows how long the review will drag on. I can't wait that long.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再这么成天闷着不开口，我怕连起音都快找不准了。
lines.en: If I keep my mouth shut like this, I'm afraid I won't even find my opening pitch.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想先去上层区的沙龙里，哪怕只上台试唱一首也行。
lines.en: I want to go to a salon on the Upper Level, even just to try one song on stage.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可真要想站上去，眼下光是拦路的坎就有三道。
lines.en: But to actually get up there, there are three hurdles in my way right now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我的名字还在禁入名录里挂着，连张通行许可证都办不下来。
lines.en: My name's still on the banned list. I can't even get a pass.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 手头更没有能进沙龙的体面衣服，总不能穿成这样上台。
lines.en: And I have nothing decent enough for a salon. I can't go on stage dressed like this.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就算能混进场子里，演出的台次名单也没人给我留空位。
lines.en: Even if I sneak in, nobody's saving me a slot on the performance list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明明连大门都进不去，却还在这儿挑剔上台的规矩。
lines.en: I can't even get through the door, and here I am fussing over stage rules.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 听着是挺寒碜的，可我还是想上去试一回。
lines.en: Sounds pathetic, I know. But I still want to try it once.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去试。
lines.en: Go try.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你嘴上倒是说得轻巧，现在连上层的门朝哪开都不容易。
lines.en: Easy for you to say. Right now even finding which way the Upper Level door opens is hard.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 歌练稳，别的我办。
lines.en: Get the song steady. I'll handle the rest.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 歌早就熟在肚子里了，现在拦路的是门和台次。
lines.en: I know that song by heart. What's blocking me is the door and the slot.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 缺哪样？
lines.en: What's missing?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 礼服店里现成有一身。
lines.en: There's a dress ready in the shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你是说前些天收进来的那条晚会礼服？
lines.en: You mean that gala gown we took in a few days ago?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 验货那天你看了半天。
lines.en: You stared at it a long time during inspection.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （偏开脸）我那是替你检查裙摆的缝线有没有脱针，少在这儿胡猜。
lines.en: (Turns away) I was checking the hem stitching for you. Stop guessing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 证和台次交给我。
lines.en: Leave the pass and the slot to me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你真能托人弄到上层的通行证，还能塞进沙龙名单？
lines.en: You can really get someone to land an Upper Level pass and squeeze me onto the salon list?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 丑话我可说在前头，去找人的时候绝不许替我讨半点情分。
lines.en: Let me be clear up front: when you ask around, don't beg a single favor on my behalf.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的案子更是半个字都不许提，谁也别想拿这事当噱头。
lines.en: And not one word about my mother's case. Nobody uses that as a gimmick.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 报幕的时候只准写我埃莉诺自己的名字。
lines.en: When they announce me, it's only my own name. Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 记下了。
lines.en: Noted.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 曲子我也挑好了，就唱以前老师总逼我练的那首旧歌。
lines.en: I've picked the song too. The old one my teacher always made me practice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那首曲子拍子快、高音又密，头一回登台就得让人记住。
lines.en: Fast tempo, dense high notes. On my first time up, they have to remember me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 而且我只唱这一首就下来，省得显得像在台上巴结谁。
lines.en: And I sing just that one and step down, so it doesn't look like I'm fawning over anyone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……这会儿巷子两头没人，我只叫你一声。
lines.en: ...No one's at either end of the alley right now. I'll say it just once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 主人，等许可证和名单办妥了，你得第一个告诉我。
lines.en: Master, once the pass and the list are settled, you tell me first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （解开袋口的旧电线）行了，趁早市还没上人，先把这袋旧货清出来。
lines.en: (Untwists the old wire on the sack) Right. Let's clear out this bag of junk before the morning market fills up.

segments.prompt_en: Response after her first failed performance

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 深夜，埃莉诺拎着沾灰的晚会礼服裙摆走到窗前，侧身坐上旧凳子。
lines.en: Late at night, Eleanor lifts the dusty hem of her gala gown, walks to the window, and sits sideways on the old stool.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这双高跟鞋简直能把脚后跟磨掉一层皮。
lines.en: These heels could strip the skin right off my heels.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一路踩着石板路走回来，脚踝都快麻木了。
lines.en: Walking back on those flagstones, my ankles nearly went numb.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行了你先别开口，听我把话讲完。
lines.en: Don't talk yet. Let me finish.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今晚的试唱已经结束了，被我彻底唱砸了。
lines.en: Tonight's audition is over. I completely blew it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我在听。
lines.en: I'm listening.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我排在第三个上台，刚站定前排还在碰杯聊订婚。
lines.en: I was third up. When I took my place, the front row was still clinking glasses about an engagement.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那些闲话一字不落地飘进耳朵里，吵得人心烦。
lines.en: Every word of that gossip drifted right into my ears. Infuriating.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱到高音那段台下还没静下来，我心里一下子急了。
lines.en: By the high notes, the crowd still hadn't quieted, and I panicked.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我越唱越快，生生把伴奏都带偏了半拍。
lines.en: I sped up more and more, and dragged the accompaniment half a beat off.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明明四分钟的曲子，三分多钟就被我草草收了尾。
lines.en: A four-minute song, and I rushed it to an end in just over three.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 台下那点掌声纯粹是客气，散场后老板只留了一句话。
lines.en: The applause was pure politeness. Afterward, the owner left me just one line.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他说我嗓子底子还在，至于登台的事以后再看。
lines.en: He said my voice still has a foundation, and we'll see about performing later.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这种委婉的逐客令，我以前在上层区从小听惯了。
lines.en: That polite brush-off, I grew up hearing it on the Upper Level.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 曲子太急了。
lines.en: The song was too fast.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这事不怪曲子，是我自己太急着让人一次记住了。
lines.en: It's not the song's fault. I was too desperate to be remembered in one go.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 在台上满脑子只顾着台下静没静，反倒忘了歌是唱给谁的。
lines.en: On stage, all I cared about was whether the crowd was quiet. I forgot who I was singing for.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……这会儿夜深了，巷子两头都没人。
lines.en: ...It's late now. No one's at either end of the alley.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……主人。
lines.en: ...Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 在沙龙里我一直绷着脸，半点破绽都没露出来。
lines.en: In the salon I kept a straight face the whole time. Didn't show a single crack.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可其实从走下台那刻起，我两只手就一直在发抖。
lines.en: But the moment I stepped off that stage, both my hands haven't stopped shaking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哪怕坐在这儿吹了半天夜风，到现在也还没停。
lines.en: I've sat here in the night wind for ages, and it still hasn't stopped.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你别低头看我的手了。
lines.en: Stop looking down at my hands.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今晚学到什么了？
lines.en: Learn anything tonight?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少摆出给人上课的架势，我心里清楚得很。
lines.en: Spare me the lecture. I know perfectly well.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 台下乱是台下的事，我自己绝不该跟着乱了阵脚。
lines.en: If the crowd's in chaos, that's their business. I should never lose my footing with them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以我打算换掉快歌，改唱前些天理货时哼的那首慢调子。
lines.en: So I'm dropping the fast song for that slow tune I hummed while sorting stock the other day.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 换首稳的。
lines.en: Pick a steadier one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱什么曲子由我自己定，但你这个稳字倒是说对了。
lines.en: I choose what I sing, but you're right about "steady."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我打算换掉那首快歌，改唱前些天理货时哼的慢调子。
lines.en: I'm dropping the fast song for that slow tune I hummed while sorting stock the other day.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那首慢歌没有花哨的高音，全靠一口气稳稳压着唱。
lines.en: That slow song has no flashy high notes. It's all about holding one steady breath.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下次再登台，底下只要有人开口说话我就立刻停下。
lines.en: Next time I'm on stage, the moment anyone talks, I stop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我就站在台上等，非等到那句话落地、全场静了再接着唱。
lines.en: I'll stand there and wait until they finish and the room goes quiet. Then I'll go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几天下了工我就回屋自己练，你可不许凑过来偷听。
lines.en: I'll practice in my room after work these next few days. Don't you dare come eavesdrop.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 台次我去问？
lines.en: Should I ask about a slot?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不用，那位老板既然说了以后再看，位置我自己去要回来。
lines.en: No. That owner said "we'll see," so I'll win the spot back myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （扶住柜台起身）下次再来，我一定正正经经走过来，不再提着裙子了。
lines.en: (Steadies herself on the counter and stands) Next time I come, I'll walk over properly. No more hitching up my skirt.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好，我不看。
lines.en: Fine. I won't look.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我打算换掉那首快歌，改唱前些天理货时哼的慢调子。
lines.en: ...I'm dropping the fast song for that slow tune I hummed while sorting stock the other day.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 巷口脚步声渐渐远去，穿晚会礼服的埃莉诺站在窗边没先出声。
lines.en: Footsteps fade down the alley. Eleanor, in her gala gown, stands by the window, silent at first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把账本递给我，今晚的账还没落笔。
lines.en: Hand me the ledger. Tonight's entry isn't written yet.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 人走远了。
lines.en: They're gone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （轻舒一口气）唱完了，今晚一个音都没抢拍。
lines.en: (Lets out a soft breath) It's done. Not a single note rushed tonight.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我还是排在第三个上台，前排照旧有人端着酒杯闲聊。
lines.en: I was third on again, and people up front were still chatting over their drinks.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我抬手让伴奏先别起调，就站在台中央看着底下。
lines.en: I raised a hand to hold the music and just stood center stage, watching them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 足足熬了三口气没出声，聊天的那两个人自己先住了嘴。
lines.en: Three full breaths in silence, and the two talkers shut up on their own.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第一句我放得极轻，连后排的客人都在往前探身子听。
lines.en: I sang the first line so softly even the back rows leaned in to hear.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱到中段我差点又要抢拍，手指按住裙侧才稳了下来。
lines.en: Midway I nearly rushed again. I pressed my fingers to my skirt and steadied.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最后一个音落下去的时候，台下静得连呼吸声都听不见。
lines.en: When the last note fell, it was so quiet you couldn't hear a breath.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我心头刚凉了半截，底下的掌声忽然响起来，拍了好久。
lines.en: My heart had half sunk when the applause suddenly broke out. It went on a long time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 老板怎么说？
lines.en: What did the owner say?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那位老板亲自走过来，再没提半句以后再看那种客套话。
lines.en: He came over himself, and not one more word of that polite "we'll see."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他当面郑重问了我的全名，我一字不省全都报给他了。
lines.en: He formally asked my full name to my face, and I gave him every word of it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下场沙龙他出钱请我再唱一晚，拿到酬劳先还你一份。
lines.en: He's paying me to sing another night at the next salon. I'll pay you a share once I'm paid.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 记下了。
lines.en: Noted.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……巷子两头这会儿没人经过。
lines.en: ...No one's passing at either end of the alley right now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……主人。
lines.en: ...Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （微俯近窗台）你从刚才起就一直盯着这身礼服看，当我没发觉吗？
lines.en: (Leans slightly toward the sill) You've been staring at this gown this whole time. Think I didn't notice?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 台下几十双眼睛盯着我都不怵，偏偏被你看着就脚底发软。
lines.en: Dozens of eyes in the crowd didn't scare me, yet with you watching, my knees go weak.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好看。
lines.en: Beautiful.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少拿两个字糊弄人，今晚的慢歌我可不在这儿唱整首。
lines.en: Don't fob me off with one word. I'm not singing the whole slow song here tonight.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她凑在窗边压低嗓子，顺着夜风轻轻哼了两句老调，到第三句便收住了声。
lines.en: Leaning by the window, she hums two lines of the old tune softly into the night wind, then stops at the third.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后头先欠着。
lines.en: I'll owe you the rest.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还差半首。
lines.en: Still half a song short.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 反正欠你的早够多了，明天我照常过来上工。
lines.en: I owe you plenty already anyway. I'll be in for work tomorrow as usual.

segments.prompt: 她拒绝拿母亲旧案作宣传

options.label: 说她划得对
options.label_en: Say she drew the line right

segments.prompt_en: She refused to use her mother's old case for publicity

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺没换那身晚会礼服就走到窗前，裙边沾着一层薄灰。
lines.en: Eleanor comes to the window still in her gala gown, its hem dusted with a thin layer of grime.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今晚连隔壁厅都搬了一排椅子过来，还是坐满了。
lines.en: Tonight they even hauled in a row of chairs from the next hall, and still every seat was filled.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后墙根底下还站着好几个端酒杯的人，整场都没挪步。
lines.en: Several more stood along the back wall with wine glasses, not moving all night.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 前排呢？
lines.en: And the front row?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回聊订婚的那对也在，今晚从头到尾没敢出声。
lines.en: The couple who chatted about their engagement last time were there. Not a peep from them all night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 慢歌起调的时候，我连裙摆都没扶就把拍子稳住了。
lines.en: When the slow song began, I held the tempo steady without even touching my hem.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱完底下一直鼓掌不肯散，伴奏直接带起了下一首前奏。
lines.en: When I finished, the applause wouldn't stop, and the band went straight into the next intro.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我只好把小时候被罚练了一整个冬天的曲子加唱了一遍。
lines.en: So I sang an encore: the piece I was forced to practice a whole winter as a child, as punishment.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今晚节目单上干干净净只有我的全名，看着就顺眼。
lines.en: Tonight's program had nothing on it but my full name. A pleasant sight.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 散场时还有位太太拿扇子点我，笑我年纪不大脾气倒不小。
lines.en: On the way out, a lady tapped me with her fan and laughed: so young, yet such a temper.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 老板呢？
lines.en: And the owner?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我正要说他，散场后他拿了下一场的节目单草稿给我看。
lines.en: I was getting to him. After the show, he showed me a draft program for the next one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我名字底下竟然多了一行小字，写着水培农场主管之女。
lines.en: Under my name was an extra line in small print: Daughter of the Hydroponic Farm Supervisor.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后头还括号注了句旧案复核中，说客人们就吃这一套。
lines.en: Then a note in brackets: "old case under review." He said guests eat that up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他还笑眯眯地跟我算，印上这一行至少能多坐满两排人。
lines.en: He even smiled while doing the math: that line would fill at least two more rows.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你让他印了？
lines.en: You let him print it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 怎么可能，我当场让他拿笔整张重抄，一个字都不准留。
lines.en: Of course not. I made him recopy the whole sheet on the spot. Not one word of it stays.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我跟他说哪怕下场空一半座位，单子上也只能印我的名字。
lines.en: I told him even if half the seats are empty next time, only my name goes on the program.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他脸色僵了半天，最后还是当着我的面重抄了一张干净的。
lines.en: His face stiffened for ages, but he recopied a clean one right in front of me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （轻叹）……其实走出沙龙大门的时候，我腿都软了。
lines.en: (Sighs softly) ...Honestly, when I walked out the salon doors, my legs were shaking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 万一下场真空了一半座位，我连跟他争辩的底气都没了。
lines.en: If half the seats really are empty next time, I won't have any ground left to argue with him.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 后悔了？
lines.en: Regretting it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 腿软归腿软，再来两次我照样让他当面划掉。
lines.en: Shaky legs or not, I'd make him strike it in front of me twice over.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先坐。
lines.en: Sit down first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺提了提裙摆，在窗边的木凳上坐下。
lines.en: Eleanor lifts her skirt and sits on the wooden stool by the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你也不先评一句对错，肯让我坐我就当你是站在我这边了。
lines.en: You didn't even say whether I was right. If you'll let me sit, I'll take it you're on my side.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 划得对。
lines.en: You were right to strike it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那位老板后来自己打了圆场，让我这几天先别应别家的约。
lines.en: The owner smoothed things over himself later and asked me not to take other bookings for a few days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他说过两天找我谈正事，多半是想把场次定下来。
lines.en: He said he'd talk business in a couple of days. Probably to lock in my dates.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……这会儿巷子两头没人，主人。
lines.en: ...No one's at either end of the alley right now, Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谢幕鼓掌的时候，我忍不住往最后排找了一圈。
lines.en: During the curtain call, I couldn't help scanning the back row.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 角落里有个穿得跟你外套同色的人，我还多看了两眼。
lines.en: Someone in the corner wore a coat the same color as yours. I looked twice.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我得看店。
lines.en: I have to mind the shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 知道你走不开，我就是当时突然想找一下。
lines.en: I know you can't get away. I just suddenly wanted to look for you then.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……下场谢幕的时候，我还往后排看。
lines.en: ...At the next curtain call, I'll still look to the back row.

scenes.title_en: That Page of the Old Contract

options.label: 问哪两晚请假
options.label_en: Ask which two nights she's off

options.label: 替她结掉旧约
options.label_en: Settle the old contract for her

segments.prompt_en: She settles the old contract and proposes a new one

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺把账本翻到最前一页，按平折痕推向你手边。
lines.en: Eleanor turns the ledger to the first page, presses the crease flat, and slides it toward you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 沙龙老板今天把驻场的日子定下来了，每个月固定两晚。
lines.en: The salon owner set my residency today. Two fixed nights a month.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 常驻名单上直接挂我的全名，一个多余的字都没加。
lines.en: The resident list carries my full name. Not one extra word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 往后上去都由沙龙出面担保通行，岗哨不再查旧禁入单了。
lines.en: From now on, the salon vouches for my passage up. The checkpoint won't check the old ban list anymore.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好事。
lines.en: Good news.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以当初为了还债签的这一页，我今天想先跟你结清。
lines.en: So this page I signed to pay off my debt... I want to settle it with you first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 虽然案子复核还没结束，那枚数据盘也还攥在我手里。
lines.en: The case review isn't over yet, and I'm still holding that data disk.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 但我现在唱歌有固定进项了，垫款从下个月起按月还你。
lines.en: But singing gives me steady income now. I'll repay your advance monthly, starting next month.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那店里的活呢？
lines.en: And the work at the shop?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你在账本后头给我留张空页，我照样过来点货记账。
lines.en: Leave me a blank page at the back of the ledger. I'll still come take stock and keep the books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 每个月就空出上台唱歌那两晚，其余日子我还归你管。
lines.en: I'll only take off the two nights I sing each month. The rest of the time, I still answer to you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 照你说的算。
lines.en: Your call.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你把笔拿起来，旧账这页得由你亲自收尾。
lines.en: Then pick up the pen. You close out the old page yourself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 哪两晚请假？
lines.en: Which two nights off?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 每月头一晚和月中那晚，排期出来我提前三天报给你。
lines.en: The first night of each month and the mid-month one. I'll tell you three days ahead once the schedule's out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先把前头这页清掉，后头那页我自己来写。
lines.en: Clear the front page first. I'll write the next one myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 旧约结清了，新页你写。
lines.en: Old deal's settled. You write the new page.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺接过账本掀到空白页，低头写下一行字。
lines.en: Eleanor takes the ledger, flips to a blank page, and writes a line.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 店员：埃莉诺；按天记工，唱歌那两晚除外。
lines.en: Clerk: Eleanor. Paid by the day, except the two singing nights.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 字迹干了，这页可就没法拿债务当借口赖掉了。
lines.en: Once the ink dries, you can't use debt as an excuse to wriggle out of this page.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那平时叫我的那声呢？
lines.en: And what you usually call me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （往巷口扫了一眼）……主人。
lines.en: (Glances toward the alley mouth) ...Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这声本来就没写在纸上，哪用得着重新签。
lines.en: That was never written on paper. No need to sign it again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下个月头一场唱完，我下了台就回来把当天的账记完。
lines.en: After my first show next month, I'll come straight back and finish the day's books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第一次唱砸了拎着裙子回来时，你这扇窗里的灯还亮着。
lines.en: The first time I bombed and came back holding up my skirt, your window's light was still on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 往后不管台上坐满多少排人，唱完了我都回这儿来。
lines.en: From now on, however many rows fill the house, I'll come back here when I'm done.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺把账本翻到最前一页，按平折痕推向你手边。
lines.en: Eleanor turns the ledger to the first page, smooths the crease, and pushes it toward you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 沙龙老板今天把驻场的日子定下来了，每个月固定两晚。
lines.en: The salon owner set my residency today. Two fixed nights a month.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 常驻名单上直接挂我的全名，一个多余的字都没加。
lines.en: The resident list carries my full name. Not one extra word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 往后上去都由沙龙出面担保通行，岗哨不再查旧禁入单了。
lines.en: From now on the salon vouches for my passage up. The checkpoint won't check the old ban list anymore.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好事。
lines.en: Good.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以当初为了还债签的这一页，我今天想先跟你结清。
lines.en: So the page I signed to pay off the debt, I want to settle with you first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 盘已经交回去了，母亲现在也平平安安跟我住在下面。
lines.en: The plate's been handed back, and Mother's living safely down here with me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我现在唱歌有固定进项了，垫款从下个月起按月还你。
lines.en: Singing gives me steady income now. I'll repay your advance monthly starting next month.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那店里的活呢？
lines.en: And the shop work?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你在账本后头给我留张空页，我照样过来点货记账。
lines.en: Leave me a blank page at the back of the ledger. I'll still come count stock and keep the books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 每个月就空出上台唱歌那两晚，其余日子我还归你管。
lines.en: I only need the two singing nights each month. The rest of the days, I'm still yours to manage.

segments.prompt: 她邀请店主去上层晚会
segments.prompt_en: She invites the shopkeeper to the Upper Level gala

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺把一张烫金厚请柬推上靠你那侧的柜台。
lines.en: Eleanor slides a thick gold-embossed invitation across the counter to your side.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上层沙龙一年一度的晚会定在明晚，请我连唱两首。
lines.en: The Upper Level salon's annual gala is tomorrow night. They want two songs from me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 老板把请柬翻来覆去查了三回，确认只印着我的全名才递给我。
lines.en: The owner checked the invitation three times to make sure only my full name was printed before handing it over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 底下还留着一个嘉宾位，以前上层的旧相识早就不来往了。
lines.en: There's a guest slot at the bottom. I cut ties with my old Upper Level acquaintances long ago.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把柜台上的笔给我用一下。
lines.en: Lend me the pen on the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 给。
lines.en: Here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （低头写下两个字又划掉重落笔）……写好了，你自己看。
lines.en: (Writes a few words, crosses them out, writes again) ...Done. See for yourself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: “我的店主”？
lines.en: "My shopkeeper"?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谁让你念出声了，检查站只认沙龙的印章又不管我怎么填！
lines.en: Who told you to read it aloud? The checkpoint only cares about the salon's seal, not what I write!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前阵子收货时我拿你肩膀比过的那件深色外套，明晚正好穿去。
lines.en: That dark coat I held up to your shoulders when we took in stock—wear it tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我跟母亲提了这事，她头一句就问你有没有能穿出门的鞋。
lines.en: I told Mother. Her first question was whether you own shoes fit to go out in.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 听我说没有，她就回了一句“那就挺直背，没人会往鞋上看”。
lines.en: When I said no, she just said, "Then stand up straight. Nobody looks at shoes."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以……明晚你跟不跟我去？
lines.en: So... are you coming with me tomorrow night?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 为什么是我？
lines.en: Why me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 除了你，这底下还有谁听过我把调子唱错的样子？
lines.en: Who else down here has heard me sing off-key?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要是带旁人去，我第二首唱到一半连眼神都没处放。
lines.en: If I brought someone else, I'd have nowhere to look halfway through the second song.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你低头盯着嘉宾栏那四个字半天没动。
lines.en: You stare at the words in the guest slot for a long while without moving.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还没看够？名字写上去又不会自己跑掉。
lines.en: Not done looking? The name won't run off the page.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我去。
lines.en: I'll go.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你明晚到了别缩在最靠后的墙角，往前排空位坐。
lines.en: When you get there tomorrow night, don't hide in the back corner. Take a seat up front.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头一首我是面朝满场客人唱的，到了第二首你眼睛不许走神。
lines.en: I'll sing the first song to the whole room, but during the second, your eyes don't wander.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （往巷口扫了一眼）……主人，明晚上了楼你可别在台下笑场。
lines.en: (Glances toward the alley entrance) ...Master, don't you dare laugh in the audience tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 请柬我放你手边了，明晚我在沙龙台阶前等你。
lines.en: I've left the invitation by your hand. I'll wait for you at the salon steps tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 柜台灯还亮着，换回女仆装的埃莉诺站在窗外，指尖轻轻搭上柜沿。
lines.en: The counter lamp is still on. Back in her maid's uniform, Eleanor stands outside the window, fingertips resting lightly on the counter's edge.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 礼服我已经挂好了，那双磨破脚后跟的鞋也终于脱了。
lines.en: The gown's hung up, and I've finally kicked off those shoes that rubbed my heels raw.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 楼上的酒杯和客套话，我可是一件都没给你带下来。
lines.en: I didn't bring a single wine glass or pleasantry down from upstairs for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……主人。
lines.en: ...Master.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 累不累？
lines.en: Tired?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我倒还好，反而是你，第二首歌我往台下看时你肩膀就没松开过。
lines.en: I'm fine. You're the one whose shoulders never relaxed when I looked down during the second song.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 快坐下把手放到柜面上来，今晚店里什么活都不许你再碰了。
lines.en: Sit down and put your hands on the counter. No more shop work for you tonight.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她隔着窗口双手捧住你的手，拇指顺着你僵硬的腕子一点点揉开。
lines.en: Through the window, she cups your hand in both of hers, her thumb slowly working the stiffness out of your wrist.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 换这身衣服了。
lines.en: You changed clothes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 看够了没有，反正这么晚巷子里也没旁人，你想看就看吧。
lines.en: Done staring? Well, there's no one else in the alley this late. Look all you want.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这个力道行不行？我是自己愿意才给你揉的，不乐意我早直说了。
lines.en: Is this pressure all right? I'm doing this because I want to. If I didn't, I'd have said so.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚好。
lines.en: Just right.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就好，给你做这些事的时候，我自己心里也高兴。
lines.en: Good. Doing these things for you makes me happy too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 对了，前阵子在这个窗口哼过的那首老调，是不是还欠你后半截？
lines.en: Oh, that old tune I hummed at this window a while back... I still owe you the second half, don't I?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那天唱到第三句就收住了，今晚正好给你补齐。
lines.en: I stopped at the third line that day. Tonight's a good time to finish it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （隔窗压低嗓子，从第三句起把剩下的半首老调轻轻哼完）
lines.en: (Lowering her voice through the window, she softly hums the rest of the old tune from the third line on)

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 很好听。
lines.en: Beautiful.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那是自然，也不看是谁专程留到半夜唱给你一个人听的。
lines.en: Naturally. Look who saved it till midnight just to sing for you alone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 欠你的这半首歌，今晚可算是连本带利全都还清了。
lines.en: That half a song I owed you? Paid back tonight, with interest.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我把柜台灯调暗一点，看你眼皮都快抬不起来了。
lines.en: I'll dim the counter lamp. You can barely keep your eyes open.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这杯热茶给你递到窗沿边了，端的时候当心烫手。
lines.en: I've set a cup of hot tea on the windowsill for you. Careful, it's hot.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 谢谢。
lines.en: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 主人，别的账都等明天再记。
lines.en: Master, the rest of the accounts can wait till tomorrow.
